brief:
Israeli authorities have released the body of a Palestinian child who was killed by Israeli fire in March, the Wafa news agency reported. The child's remains had been held by Israeli authorities since the killing took place earlier this year.

The release of the body comes months after the incident. Further details about the circumstances surrounding the child's death and the specific identity of the slain child were not immediately available in initial reports of the handover.
